# Third-party source adaptations

The procedural audio modules in `src/audio/procedural/`, their coordinator
`src/audio/procedural.rs`, and the limiter adapt portions of
[kvmet/NoiseMachine](https://github.com/kvmet/NoiseMachine), commit
`e709f125b8f8e85780c466ddf6c850ae90026748` (MIT, Copyright 2026 kvmet).
The full required notice is preserved in [NoiseMachine-LICENSE](NoiseMachine-LICENSE).
Port scope and differences are described in [the audio foundation](../docs/audio/FOUNDATION.md).
